views.finding: All three audio sockets show open circular bores; CV and GATE show native metal lips and recesses. Power pin, USB and DIN contacts remain.
All eleven rear ports visible. Audio interior contact leaves, CV/GATE recesses, power center pin, USB tongue and recessed five-contact DIN inserts remain; obsolete closing disks are absent.
Original complete enclosure, knobs, forty native LED lenses and twenty-three caps retain their assembled appearance; no blank render or clipping.
Original case, panels and board separation retained; LED and cap apertures remain empty with complete PCB-mounted controls following the mainboard.
Original native PCB controls retained; forty complete LEDs and twenty-three bare switches visible, with caps intentionally hidden.
Original twenty-four illustrative wires, endpoint labels and physical-fit qualifications remain; complete I/O board and regulator/heatsink retained.
